# Sorghum: Species Guidance

Sorghum is a diploid cereal with diversity panels, structured germplasm, and
breeding applications. Specify whether the study concerns grain, sweet,
forage, broomcorn, or wild-related germplasm because population structure and
trait architecture can differ. Use chromosome-specific maps and retain
family/subpopulation labels for GWAS and genomic-selection validation.
